comment: The CMS page shown as the storefront home page.
modal: Selects which existing CMS page is used as the storefront home page. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: The CMS page shown when a requested page is not found (404).
modal: Selects the CMS page displayed when a URL does not match any route, i.e. a 404. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: The CMS page shown when the visitor's browser has cookies disabled.
modal: Selects the CMS page displayed when a visitor's browser has cookies disabled. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether breadcrumb navigation is shown on CMS pages.
modal: When **Yes**, breadcrumb navigation is displayed on CMS pages. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether visitors with cookies disabled are redirected to the No Cookies CMS page.
modal: When **Yes**, visitors whose browsers have cookies disabled are redirected to the configured CMS No Cookies page. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether a notice is shown to visitors who have JavaScript disabled.
modal: When **Yes**, a notice is displayed to visitors whose browsers have JavaScript disabled. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether a notice is shown to visitors who have local storage disabled.
modal: When **Yes**, a notice is displayed to visitors whose browsers have local storage disabled. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: The default page layout applied to CMS pages.
modal: The layout (for example 1 column or 2 columns) used by default for CMS pages that do not specify their own.

comment: Whether and how the WYSIWYG rich-text editor is available for content fields.
modal: Controls whether the WYSIWYG rich-text editor is available for content fields and how it is presented. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Selects which WYSIWYG editor adapter is used for content fields.
modal: Selects the WYSIWYG editor adapter used for rich-text content fields. Relates to the Enable WYSIWYG Editor setting. Can be set per website.
